"🦖 PRIMAL ISLAND: 3D DINOSAUR SURVIVAL ADVENTURE

Create a fully playable, open-world 3D dinosaur survival game inspired by ARK: Survival Evolved.

🌴 1. WORLD @COMMENT_BODY@ ENVIRONMENT

Create an enormous, beautiful, explorable prehistoric island featuring:

- Massive tropical beaches with realistic white sand.
- Deep oceans with underwater environments.
- Dense forests filled with giant trees, bushes, and vegetation.
- Mountains, cliffs, caves, rivers, waterfalls, and hidden valleys.
- Small islands surrounding the main island.
- Dynamic day and night cycle.
- Realistic weather, including rain, fog, storms, and sunlight.
- Atmospheric lighting, shadows, reflections, and realistic environmental effects.

The world should feel alive, immersive, and full of things to discover.

🌊 2. REALISTIC WATER PHYSICS

Water is extremely important.

Implement:

- Real-time animated ocean waves.
- Dynamic wave movement and shoreline foam.
- Realistic water reflections.
- Swimming and underwater movement.
- Water reacting visually to the player and creatures.
- Rivers with flowing water.
- Underwater plants, rocks, and aquatic creatures.
- Realistic water depth and transparency.

Water should look and behave as realistically as possible.

🦕 3. DINOSAURS @COMMENT_BODY@ WILDLIFE

Populate the island with different living creatures.

Include:

- Tyrannosaurus Rex.
- Triceratops.
- Stegosaurus.
- Velociraptors.
- Brontosaurus.
- Pteranodons.
- Ankylosaurus.
- Parasaurolophus.
- Crocodiles.
- Other prehistoric and modern wildlife.

Every creature should have:

- Unique 3D models.
- Animated walking, running, and idle animations.
- Different movement speeds and sizes.
- Health and attack damage.
- Natural AI behaviors.
- Different personalities.
- Environmental interactions.

Some dinosaurs are peaceful, while others are territorial or aggressive.

Dinosaurs should wander around naturally instead of standing in one place.

👹 4. FOREST BOSSES @COMMENT_BODY@ ENCOUNTERS

Exploring the island should become increasingly dangerous.

When the player wanders deep into forests, explores caves, or reaches remote locations, they can encounter powerful creatures and bosses.

Examples:

- Alpha T-Rex: gigantic, powerful, and extremely aggressive.
- Ancient Titan: enormous prehistoric forest boss.
- Shadow Raptor: fast predator that hunts in dark forests.
- Swamp Devourer: giant creature living in dangerous swamps.

Boss encounters should be unexpected and exciting.

Give bosses:

- Huge health bars.
- Unique attack patterns.
- Special animations.
- Increased damage.
- Distinct appearances.
- Boss encounter music and atmosphere.

Do not spawn bosses directly beside the player. Make discovering them part of exploration.

⚔️ 5. COMBAT SYSTEM

Create a responsive third-person combat system.

The player must have:

Normal Attack

- Fast attack.
- Short cooldown.
- Deals normal damage.

Heavy Attack

- Slower, stronger attack.
- More damage.
- Longer cooldown.
- Powerful animation.

Dash

- Quick directional movement.
- Short cooldown.
- Useful for dodging enemy attacks.

Add:

- Hit detection.
- Enemy damage.
- Player health.
- Enemy health bars.
- Combat animations.
- Damage feedback.
- Boss health bars.

Combat must actually work, not just display buttons.

🎮 6. MOBILE CONTROLS @COMMENT_BODY@ UI

Design the entire game for mobile touchscreen gameplay.

Left side:

- Virtual joystick for movement.

Right side:

- Normal attack button.
- Heavy attack button.
- Dash button.
- Jump button.

Additional UI:

- Player health bar.
- Stamina bar.
- Inventory button.
- Map button.
- Pause/settings button.
- Boss health bar when fighting bosses.

Buttons must be responsive and properly positioned for mobile screens.

The camera should smoothly follow the player and allow camera rotation.

🧍 7. PLAYER SYSTEM

Create a fully animated third-person human character.

Include:

- Walking.
- Running.
- Sprinting.
- Jumping.
- Swimming.
- Attacking.
- Dodging.
- Taking damage.
- Death and respawn.
I'll update the game soon to getmore (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

- Build a complete, playable mobile-friendly 3D dinosaur survival game called “Primal Island” in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Create an explorable prehistoric island with beaches, ocean, forest, mountains, wildlife, and day/night and weather effects.
- Add animated water, third-person movement, swimming, combat, health/stamina, pickups, inventory, quests, dinosaur AI, and remote boss encounters.

- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Use Three.js via a CDN and custom-generated geometry rather than external assets.
- Provide desktop keyboard/mouse controls and mobile touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a game HUD, title screen, pause/map/inventory modals, and mobile control layouts in `index.html` and `style.css`.
- Began Three.js island generation, vegetation, rocky details, islets, ocean shader, and shoreline foam in `game.js`.

### Active
- Finish the playable game systems and connect UI interactions to gameplay.
- Validate the game in a browser and fix runtime or visual issues.

### Blocked
- `game.js` is currently incomplete: it contains only the initial world-generation section; gameplay, creatures, player, UI logic, and animation loop still need implementation.

1. Continue implementing `game.js`: player and creature models/AI, controls, combat, survival pickups, quests, HUD, modals, and render loop.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface, HUD, title screen, controls, and modals.

- `game.js`: Partial Three.js world implementation; primary work in progress.

## Important Context
- The latest `game.js` write replaced the earlier attempted gameplay code and currently ends after world details; do not assume earlier creature/player/gameplay implementation remains.
- No browser testing or screenshot verification has occurred yet.
